international.title: Microsoft ‘seeing positive results’ from attempts to fix global outage affecting Teams and Outlook
international.summary: Microsoft 365 also hit but tech company says no indication problem was caused by cyber-attack Microsoft outage – live updates Microsoft has said it is “seeing positive results” from its efforts to fix an outage of some of its systems that has caused huge disruption to users, organisations and businesses across the globe. The tech company said it is attempting to improve capacity to enable more users to get back on its systems, after a global outage affected thousands of users for more than 12 hours on Thursday and Friday.
